{{main|Nomenclature of Territorial Units for Statistics}}

In the '''NUTS''' (Nomenclature of Territorial Units for Statistics) codes of '''[[Romania]]''' (RO), the three levels are:

{| class="wikitable"
|-
! Level
! Subdivisions
! #
|-
! [[First level NUTS of the European Union#Romania|NUTS 1]]
| Macroregions (''Macroregiuni'')
| align="right" | 4
|-
! NUTS 2
| [[Development regions of Romania|Regions]] (''Regiuni'')
| align="right" | 8
|-
! NUTS 3
| [[Counties of Romania|Counties]] + [[Bucharest]] (''Județe + București'')
| align="right" | 42
|}

==Local administrative units==
{{main|Local administrative unit}}

Below the NUTS levels, the two LAU (Local Administrative Units) levels are:

{| class="wikitable"
|-
! Level
! Subdivisions
! #
|-
! LAU 1
| — (same as NUTS 3)
| align="right" | 42
|-
! LAU 2
| [[Municipalities of Romania|Communes + Towns + Municipalities (Cities) ]] (''Comune + Orașe + Municipii'')
| align="right" | 3180
|}

''The LAU codes of Romania can be downloaded here:'' {{XLSlink|[http://ec.europa.eu/eurostat/ramon/nuts/excel_files/RO_LAU_2007.xls]}}
